model.name: Add a repository by entering a server-local path to register an existing checkout
model.description: In the add dialog, entering a SERVER-LOCAL PATH (e.g. /root/oosh) registers that existing checkout as a repo in the dynamic registry, usable in the selector. Shared IMPL-ENABLER (architect's decomposition, NOT a separate Tron-observable): the RepoRegistry becomes a DYNAMIC, mutable, persisted registry (add/register/clone/switch at runtime) - superseding the R30.40 static ROOTS allowlist. Architect derives the impl-units (dynamic-registry / add-local / add-clone / manage-switch); I mint/re-point methods+impls on confirm.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The dialog accepts a SERVER-LOCAL PATH (e.g. /root/oosh) and registers that existing checkout as a repo in the dynamic registry.
After registering, the new repo APPEARS in the repo selector and is usable for diffs/merges (resolves via the dynamic RepoRegistry).
The path is validated server-side (exists + is a git checkout); an invalid path is rejected with a clear error (no path abuse).

RATIFIED D1: the server-local path, after realpath (symlinks resolved), MUST be within the HOME subtree OR the REPO_ALLOW allowlist; a realpath outside those bounds is REJECTED (symlink-escape blocked).
RATIFIED D4: registering a repo requires the admin-key (all writes are admin-key-gated); missing/invalid admin-key -> rejected, nothing registered.
RATIFIED D4: the registration persists in the dynamic registry (survives restart) via an admin-key-gated write; no secret/path leakage.
GATE (DET-3x + Tron visual): register /root/oosh -> it appears in the selector + opens a diff; client-facing -> version-bump.

model.securitySurface: SECURITY SURFACE RATIFIED by Tron D1-D4 (2026-07-19): D1 path-bounds = HOME-subtree + REPO_ALLOW, realpath-checked; D2 clone SSRF = host-allowlist (github.com+team) + https/ssh only (reject file/git/ext); D3 worktree switch = READ-ONLY ref-pick, worktree-as-key, NO server checkout; D4 auth = admin-key for ALL writes (register/clone/registry-mutation). Read-only actions need no admin-key.
